narrative:
## Handover Summary — Loan Pricing & Margin

Risk-based loan pricing is approved, defending lending NII through the cutting cycle.

## Key Decisions
- +25bp risk-based repricing on SME working-capital renewals
- VeloLeasing vendor programme growth in Wielkopolska and Lower Silesia
- Pre-approved instalment offers to ex-Citi Warsaw cardholders within the APR cap

## Recommendation for ALM & Repricing Gap
With deposit and loan pricing set, ALM should size the receive-fixed swap overlay to the remaining short-dated asset-sensitive gap.

## Risk Factors
- Cost of risk normalising above 0.62%
- Mortgage prepayment acceleration as rates fall

signals.title: SME Credit Demand Survey
signals.excerpt: Banks report rising SME demand for working-capital and investment loans, with credit standards broadly unchanged and spreads stable.

signals.title: WIBOR to WIRON Transition Roadmap
signals.excerpt: The National Working Group confirmed the timetable for replacing WIBOR with WIRON in new loan contracts, affecting the repricing profile of variable-rate mortgages.
